product.name: Hamyonimda
product.description: Independent product: AI-powered personal finance for Uzbekistan, delivered through a Telegram bot, Mini App and web dashboard.
bullets: Built and deployed the product from scratch: Go REST APIs, Vue/Nuxt interfaces, PostgreSQL, Redis/Asynq workers, payment integrations and Docker-based CI/CD on a self-managed VPS.
Developed voice and bank-SMS intake with speech-to-text and structured LLM outputs. Added language-aware retries, provider fallback and partial-input recovery for Uzbek/Russian financial commands.
Improved amount extraction from 25/38 to 35/38 correct cases (66% to 92%) on a 38-example evaluation set by comparing speech-recognition and LLM parsing configurations.
Developed Hami, a Go-based financial assistant with tool calling, server-scoped user access, deterministic monetary calculations and numerical-answer verification against tool results.
Built multilingual evaluations for tool selection, numerical correctness, refusals and prompt injection, tracking latency and model cost; implemented an MCP server with OAuth and PKCE.

Expanded from frontend to full-stack responsibilities in July 2026. Built Go/Gin APIs, PostgreSQL persistence and tests for vehicle-service workflows, including MyGov integrations and NAPP insurance transaction callbacks.

Built the Vue 3/TypeScript frontend for an SME financing product from scratch, including multi-step applications, state management and review workflows. The product received 273 applications and UZS 21B in approved limits within two weeks of launch.
Developed and published an internal MCP server for a private UI library, exposing component search, listings and details to AI development tools.
Raised Lighthouse performance from 54 to 74 and accessibility from 66 to 87; introduced Lighthouse CI quality gates and optimized image delivery, lazy loading and code splitting.
Implemented E-IMZO digital signatures, MyID and KATM integrations, multi-limit business logic and WebSocket dashboards; contributed across nine product teams.
